issues.detail: The Greek phrase 'ου γινωσκει την εφεσιων πολιν νεωκορον ουσαν' describes the city of Ephesus as 'being a temple' (neokoron ousan). The Vietnamese translation renders this as 'người thờ phượng' (worshipper/one who worships), which changes the subject from the city being a temple to people being worshippers.
